component.name: SnapIntel
component.summary: See what a public Snapchat profile shares

description.p: Type a Snapchat username and SnapIntel shows what that public profile shares: its details, story, highlights, Spotlight videos and lenses. Save any of it with a record you can verify later. It needs no Snapchat account and never asks you to sign in.

ul.li: The whole profile from a username: name, badge, subscribers, bio, Snapcode and related accounts
A viewer that shows each Spotlight's views, comments, sound, language, top comments and captions
Downloads recorded with their source, upload date and SHA-256, so a folder can be checked later
Insights: upload times, uploads per month, hashtags, categories and languages
Export a profile as JSON, or as a CSV with one row per item

description.p: SnapIntel reads only the profile's public page on snapchat.com. It never reads location data or who wrote a comment, and it does not monitor profiles. It is an independent project, not affiliated with Snap Inc.
